ref: #2 §5 Arithmetic: FormatNum takes a java.text.DecimalFormat pattern [SAP✓ https://help.sap.com/docs/SAP_NETWEAVER_750/0b9668e854374d8fa3fc8ec327ff3693/4bfbd16f66d33de4e10000000a42189e.html]; ADR-0003: the pattern is translated to the XPath picture 0.##; assumed reading: DecimalFormat over the xs:decimal (ADR-0005) with the symbols . and , (obs-arithmetic fmt-006)
note: A pattern without a 0: DecimalFormat still writes one integer digit, so 0.5 gives 0.5, 0 gives 0 and 3.125 gives 3.12. The XPath picture #.## would give .5 and .0, so the picture is 0.##.
